name: Craft Axe Throwing Springfield
address: 431 S Jefferson Ave, Suite 132A, Springfield, MO 65806

booking.howItWorks: Book standard lanes online. For groups of around 10+ throwers, buyouts and corporate events, contact the venue for custom pricing and availability. Off-hours private events need at least one week of notice.

packages.name: 45-Minute Session
packages.description: Pay by the thrower. Up to 4 throwers per lane. Ninja stars and The Stick All not included.

packages.name: 1-Hour Session
packages.description: $23 each for 1–2 throwers, $21 each for 3+ throwers. Up to 4 throwers per lane. Large ninja star and The Stick All not included.

packages.name: 1.5-Hour Session
packages.description: $33 each for 1–2 throwers, $30 each for 3+ throwers. Up to 4 throwers per lane.

packages.name: Monday Lane Special
packages.description: Fill a lane with up to 6 throwers for $80 per 1-hour session. Mondays only.

packages.name: Large Group / Facility Rental
packages.description: Buyouts, parties and corporate events. Reserve multiple lanes or the whole venue. Event pricing kicks in at 10+ throwers; custom pricing - contact the venue. Capacity over 80 people.

faq.q: What age do you have to be?
faq.a: A safe, welcoming environment for all ages 10 and up (with a parent present for minors). All participants must sign a waiver before throwing.
Closed-toe shoes are required for all participants - no sandals, flip-flops, or open-toed shoes. Beyond that, wear whatever you're comfortable in.

faq.q: Can we bring outside food and drinks?
faq.a: Outside food and catering are welcome - just bring your own utensils and napkins. Outside drinks are not permitted; we serve craft beer, seltzers, and other beverages on site.
Free on-site parking (a real lot, not an app).
Rescheduling is available for events. Refunds are not provided for cancellations. Please contact the venue as soon as possible if your plans change.
No - watching is always free. Only active throwers need a session.

faq.q: How many people can you host?
faq.a: 12 lanes, up to 4 throwers per lane, and a capacity of over 80 people. Event pricing kicks in at 10+ throwers; smaller crews just book a lane online.

faq.q: Can we book outside normal hours?
faq.a: Yes - off-hours private events are available with at least one week of advance notice. Contact the venue to discuss availability and pricing.

faq.q: Do I need to book ahead?
faq.a: Strongly recommended, especially Friday/Saturday nights and weekends. Walk-ins are welcome when lanes are open.
Yes. Every session includes a safety briefing and hands-on coaching from a trained instructor. No experience necessary.
Every venue is wheelchair accessible. We can adapt the throwing setup for seated throwers - just let us know in advance.

Monday: fill a lane with up to 6 throwers for $80 per 1-hour session. Thursday: ladies throw for 50% off (groups of four or fewer). Sunday: kids 10–15 throw free with an equivalent purchased regular session; adult must be present.

faq.q: Do you have a birthday program?
faq.a: Join the Birthday Club and throw for free on your birthday. You'll get an email the week of your birthday; show it when you arrive.

faq.q: What else is there to do?
faq.a: Ninja stars, The Stick All, cornhole, giant jenga, table games, HDTVs, and the RC Dirt Box (ages 5 and up).
WATL-sanctioned 8-week leagues; most start around $135–$145 for the season. Contact the venue for the next start date.
